headline: Sensex Tumbles Nearly 1,000 Points as IT Stocks Lead Market Sell-Off

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Profit booking snapped a two-day rally in the Indian equity markets.
Heavy selling pressure in IT stocks dragged key benchmark indices lower.
Sensex tumbled nearly 1,000 points and Nifty 50 dropped below the 25,650 level.
Sectoral losses in IT outweighed gains in outperforming metal stocks.
whatHappening: Sensex crashed between 700 to nearly 1,000 points while Nifty 50 slipped below 25,650.
IT stocks led the market decline throughout the trading session.
RBI reduced the daily CRR maintenance requirement back to 90% starting December 1.
Karnataka issued a show-cause notice to an IOC terminal regarding ethanol blending.
summary: Indian stock markets snapped a two-day rally on November 27 as the Sensex tumbled nearly 1,000 points and Nifty 50 slipped below 25,650. The sell-off was primarily led by heavy selling pressure in IT stocks, though metal stocks showed outperformance. Meanwhile, Karnataka issued a show-cause notice to an IOC terminal over ethanol blending.
